artworks.title: Mengoon: Ruined Griffins
artworks.description: The image features two large stone structures on either side, sparse vegetation, bushes, a body of water meeting the horizon, and a tree line under an overcast sky. The image has a monochromatic sepia tone, emphasizing the light and shadow on the stone structures.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Toung-lay-lou-tiy Kyoung
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an intricately carved architectural structure. The structure appears to be a part of a historic building or temple, showcasing ornate and detailed embellishments on its surface. This photograph captures the building's facade, which features decorative arches, pillars, and a series of sculptural elements that create a sense of grandeur and artistic craftsmanship. The texture and pattern of the carvings stand out, showing the care and skill involved in their creation. The surrounding appears to be blurred, perhaps due to movement during the exposure.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: South Ditch of the City Wall
artworks.description: The image shows a still waterway stretching into the distance. The horizon is high, with flat land, distant hills, and a cloudy sky. Faint outlines of architectural structures with pointed roofs lie on the horizon. The image has a slightly grainy texture and sepia tones. The water reflects the sky, and a sloped embankment leads to a fenced area with a thatched roof structure and palm trees.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Magwe Wundouk Kyoung
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure viewed from ground level. The building is a traditional palace with ornate, tiered roofs and intricate carvings. The horizon is low in the frame, emphasizing the roofline which stretches horizontally. The sky is overcast with soft clouds, casting subtle shadows. The image has a historical appearance, possibly with a sepia tone. It is dominated by shades of brown and grey, enhancing the vintage feel. The surroundings are simple, with posts and pathways leading to the building. Trees can be seen in the distance on either side, framing the architectural silhouette against the sky.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Pyee-dyk Kyoung
artworks.description: The image shows a traditional building with intricate architecture, pointed spires, and ornate detailing. The perspective is slightly elevated, providing a comprehensive view of the structure. The rooflines are prominent, leading the viewer's gaze upward. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Vegetation and pathways lead up to the building in the foreground, surrounded by a low fence and shrubbery. Trees are visible in the distance. The sky above is clear.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Ouk Kyoung
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure in a landscape. The horizon is high with a sky filled with clouds. The structure has multiple tiers, intricate spires, and carved facades. It extends horizontally beyond a grassy area. Vegetation with a wooden fence is in the foreground. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing textures and forms with a vintage, grainy style. The tones are muted, giving the scene a timeless and serene quality.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Ooh-nein Gate of the City
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure with traditional Asian design on the right side. There is a wall extending to the left, separating the ground and the sky. A tree and a couple of palm trees are on the left, adding a natural element. The photo appears to be monochromatic or sepia-toned, giving it a vintage feel. The ground is dry and flat, with a path leading to the building and tree. The sky is overcast with a uniform tone, contributing to the muted color palette.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Sindu Shwe koo Pagoda
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene viewed from ground level. There is an ornate structure and large stone sculptures. The horizon, clouds, temple with spires and arches, stone guardians, palm trees, foliage, and scattered stones are part of the scene. The image has a monochromatic color palette with shades of brown and cream, giving a vintage effect.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: My-au-dyk Kyoung
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate traditional building surrounded by lush vegetation. The building has intricate rooflines and pointed spires against the sky. The scene has a monochromatic sepia color palette. The ground is uneven with patches of grass and a path leading into the distance. A tall palm tree stands to the right, with dense trees and bushes surrounding the building.

artworks.title: Pugahm Myo: East Facade of Damayangyee Pagoda
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient temple-like structure with intricate architectural details. The scene is closely cropped around the building, which features arched doorways, detailed carvings, and steps. The architecture is ornate, worn, and aged. The image is rendered in sepia tones, giving it a historical feel. The sky is relatively clear with some scattered clouds in the background.

artworks.title: Pugahm Myo: Entrance to the Shwe Zeegong Pagoda
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient temple complex viewed from ground level. The horizon is obscured by temple walls, spires, and architectural features. The composition includes a large ornate gateway with lion statues, surrounded by other temples and stupas with pointed roofs. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving a historical feel. Trees, including palm trees, are present, contrasting with the horizontal lines of the walls. Carvings and tall structures add to the grandeur of the scene.

artworks.title: Pugahm Myo: Carved Doorway in Courtyard of Shwe Zeegong Pagoda
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a wooden building with intricate architectural details. The gable end is adorned with swirling patterns and decorative elements. The entrance has a slightly arched doorway surrounded by detailed woodwork, with a carved panel above it. The roof edges have decorative trim and flourishes. In the background are tall palm trees and foliage. The craftsmanship of the building showcases attention to detail and artistry, capturing a moment of cultural heritage in wooden architecture.

artworks.title: Tsagain Myo: Ruined Tazoung
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden structure with intricate design, potentially a religious building like a pagoda or temple. The view is slightly elevated, offering a clear sight of the architecture. The horizon is hidden by the main structure and surroundings. The architecture includes steeply sloping roofs with detailed carvings, typical of Southeast Asian design. Below the closest roofed section, Buddha statues are visible among foliage. The image has a muted, sepia-toned color palette, emphasizing textures and details in the carvings. In the background, there are more pagoda-like structures and greenery, creating an atmospheric scene.

artworks.title: Tsagain Myo: Doorway of a Small Pagoda
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a richly decorated architectural structure. The image depicts an ornately carved entrance, with intricate floral motifs and elaborate detailing in its stonework. The doorway has a pointed arch sealed with frames, flanked by columns topped with carvings. The structure is bordered by a decorative frieze. The lower part of the photograph shows vegetation. The aged appearance of the stone and overall composition hints at the historical or ancient character of the structure.

artworks.title: Tsagain Myo: View near the Irrawadi River
artworks.description: The image shows a waterside scene with a small house on stilts among trees. The horizon is where the trees meet the sky, with the house and treetops visible. The photo has a sepia tone, creating a vintage look with brown and cream colors. The ground has logs and branches, hinting at a rustic setting. Trees fill the background, with a palm tree on the right. The house is elevated above water, suggesting flooding. The sky has a soft light, contributing to the peaceful ambiance.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Portico of the Residency
artworks.description: The image shows a traditional building with a thatched roof positioned slightly right of center. Tall palm trees with sparse fronds rise above the building, dominating the skyline and infringing into the sky. The horizon is obscured by trees and foliage surrounding the structure. The ground is dusty, leading to the raised construction supported by numerous pillars. The structure is slightly elevated with a ramp on the right side and a partially enclosed balcony visible. The color palette is monochromatic with a sepia tone, giving a vintage feel. The image displays detailed photographic quality with a contrast between the structure's texture and the smooth sky.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: West Gate of the Residency Enclosure
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with traditional bamboo and thatch-roofed structures among palm trees. The background is filled with tall palm trees. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones. The ground has scattered leaves and tree shadows. The image conveys a tranquil and timeworn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Barracks of the Burmese Guard
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic village scene with thatched roof huts on the right side. Tall palm trees stand out against the low horizon. A large tree occupies the left side of the image, while the huts are made of natural materials with woven walls and thatched roofs. The color scheme is monochromatic with earthy browns and grays. Shadows and light create texture, and an open pathway leads from the tree to the huts. In the distance, more trees and fields are visible.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Mygabhoodee-tee Kyoung from East
artworks.description: The image shows a traditional building with intricate roof designs, partially obscured by trees on each side. The horizon is not visible due to the dense foliage and the structure dominating the upper part of the scene. The photo captures the building nestled among large trees, with some treetops rising above the structure. The architecture features ornate, tiered roofs with pointed spires reaching upwards. Closest to us, there are small, neatly trimmed shrubs and a pot with a plant, contrasting with the grandiose elements beyond. The color palette is monochromatic sepia, giving the image an aged, historical feel. The image appears to be a photograph.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: View amongst the Pagodas near the Statue
artworks.description: The image displays two traditional buildings with detailed architectural features. A tall palm tree is situated between the buildings, and lush greenery can be seen beyond them. The image has a monochromatic palette with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Thayet Myo: Pagoda on the South of Cantonment
artworks.description: The image shows a temple structure with tiered spires, detailed carvings, and pointed domes in the center. Tall palm trees frame the scene on both sides. Lush vegetation, scaffolding, and trees are visible around the temple. The color palette is monochromatic, giving the image a vintage look.

artworks.title: The Church of S. Gregorio Magno on the Celian Hill (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from an elevated perspective. There is a building in the distance with a bell tower. The horizon is high in the image. The drawing style is detailed with precise line work. The color scheme is primarily brown. Closest to us, a stone structure with arches is partially visible, and a few figures are seated on sloped terrain.

artworks.title: Southern Italian Woman Dressed for Church
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper, prepared with beige gouache(?)
artworks.creditLine: Florian Carr Fund and The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: This image is a pastel drawing. It shows portions of three figures. The central figure's torso and arms are more completely represented, holding a white fabric adorned with patterns and a black beaded necklace. Their clothing includes a detailed, multicolored sleeve with geometric patterns and a long white skirt. The head and upper body outlines of this figure are visible, but facial features are not detailed. Two more figures are behind the central one, with obscured backgrounds and facial features. They are dressed similarly, with one wearing a hat and the other displaying a richly patterned sleeve and white skirt. The background is a plain, beige surface, highlighting the figures' vividly patterned clothing and softly shadowed outlines.

artworks.title: The Assassination of Saint Peter Martyr
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated and slightly angled view capturing figures in a landscape. Trees obscure the high horizon, the intricately engraved textures enhancing details in vegetation, clothing, and tree bark. The monochrome color palette accentuates contrast for form and depth. Two robed figures struggle on a slope, framed by trees, while another figure gestures with a sword nearby. Leafy trees fill the background, blending into a sky with clouds.
